text.label: Text
text.value: WE PLAY HONG KONG STYLE MAHJONG.

text.label: Text
text.value: Four players sit around the table. Each player draws and discards tiles to build a winning hand of 14 tiles.

text.label: Text
text.value: 144 tiles total: 3 suits (Characters, Bamboo, Circles 1–9), Honor tiles (Winds + Dragons), and Bonus tiles (Flowers + Seasons).

text.label: Text
text.value: Form 4 sets (Pong, Kong, or Chow) plus 1 pair. Declare Mahjong when your hand is complete — either by self-draw or claiming a discard.

text.label: Text
text.value: Pong = 3 identical tiles. Kong = 4 identical tiles. Chow = 3 consecutive tiles of the same suit. Only the player whose turn it is can Chow.

text.label: Text
text.value: Yes, come anyway. Instructors walk through basics before each session. No experience needed — just curiosity and patience.

text.label: Text
text.value: Just yourself. Tiles and tables are provided. Arrive 15 minutes early if it is your first time.
